controls.name: Check for updates
controls.tip: Ask GitHub about every product now. It only reads public release data; nothing is sent about you or this computer.

controls.name: Settings
controls.tip: Look, hover bubbles and where Linux plugins go.

controls.name: About
controls.tip: What this is, what it collects (nothing), and how to remove it.

controls.name: Updates tab
controls.tip: Products that have a newer version than the one installed.

controls.name: Not installed tab
controls.tip: Products that are not installed here yet.

controls.name: All tab
controls.tip: Every Studio 87 product, including ones that only link to GitHub.

controls.name: Update selected
controls.tip: Update the products you ticked, one after another.

controls.name: Update all
controls.tip: Update every product that has a newer version. Products with an unknown installed version are left alone.

controls.name: Row tick box
controls.tip: Tick to include this product in 'Update selected'.

controls.name: Update / Install button
controls.tip: Download, verify the SHA256 checksums, then install 0.2.4. Installers are not code-signed: Windows or macOS may show a warning. Nothing is installed until you click.

controls.name: Changelog button
controls.tip: Read the release notes for every version newer than the one you have.

controls.name: GitHub button
controls.tip: Open the project page in your browser.

controls.name: Smaller window
controls.tip: Make the window smaller. You can also drag any edge or corner; the shape stays the same.

controls.name: Back to 100 percent
controls.tip: Back to the normal size. Double click on either wood side does the same.

displays.name: Screenshot and cat icon
displays.text: The product's own docs/screenshot.png, small, with the cat icon on it, so you recognise it at a glance. Fetched during the check and saved on disk.

displays.name: Name, kind and build type
displays.text: Product name, its kind (VST3 plugin, standalone app, hardware controller, logue unit) and TEST BUILD when the release is marked as one.

displays.name: Installed and latest version
displays.text: What is really installed (read from the plugin's own metadata or from what this updater installed) and the newest release on GitHub. 'unknown' and 'not installed' are shown honestly.

displays.name: Status
displays.text: Update available, Up to date, Not installed, Installed version unknown, No release yet, Could not check, or View on GitHub. While updating it turns into Downloading, Verifying SHA256, Installing.

displays.name: Changelog line
displays.text: The first line of the release notes. The Changelog button shows the notes of every version newer than yours.

displays.name: Date, size and install route
displays.text: Release date, download size and how this product gets installed on this system. 'saved list' means the answer came from disk (offline or rate limited).

displays.name: Status line
displays.text: When the last check happened and how many updates were found. Offline and rate-limit messages appear here and in red on the right.

displays.name: Page counter
displays.text: Five products per page, so the window never needs a scrollbar.

displays.name: Size read-out
displays.text: Window size in pixels and, on the 100% button, the zoom relative to the default size.

displays.name: Wood sides
displays.text: Double click on either wood side to go back to the default size (100%).
